title: Contoso Travel Policy
content: For Project Northstar, the internal travel approval code is NS-4827. International travel requires director approval at least 14 calendar days before departure.

title: Contoso Support Policy
content: Priority-one incidents use the internal escalation phrase Blue Lantern and require an incident commander within 15 minutes.

title: Contoso Data Retention
content: Synthetic customer case exports are retained for 30 days in the Atlas test environment.
